decisions.statement: A body is formatted where the body is handed in before anything judges the body.
The formatter the repo already stands on is reached inside the root the formatting is run for.
Formatting sorts the imports as well as the spacing.
Import order is enforced.
A body that only had its spacing fixed still fails.
The body that comes back is taken only when the run exited clean and said something.
A body that would not parse leaves the formatter silent.
Silence is never a body.
Anything short of that answers the body handed in unchanged.
A body that cannot be parsed is then refused on its own merits rather than quietly blanked.
A body of a kind the formatter does not own comes back unformatted.
The formatter answers a heavy check mark as a square root sign.
The formatter answers a zero-width space as the replacement character.
The formatter makes those substitutions whatever kind the path names.
A formatting that changes the characters outside ASCII is not taken.
Those characters are compared as a sorted bag.
Reordering those characters is not changing those characters.
A body whose marks would change comes back unformatted rather than refused.
Whether a body moved is answered beside that body.
A run here is held to the processors a run made to lint is held to.
Many bodies are formatted in one run of the formatter.
Those bodies are written into a scratch root outside the repository.
A body sits in that root at the path the body has in the repository.
The config and the ignore file the root holds are carried into that scratch root.
A body is judged by the bytes read back rather than by the code the run exited with.
A body that does not come back is answered as the body handed in.
A body the formatter read only part of comes back as far as the formatter got.
A run over many bodies rewrites a body no run over a single body would touch.
The formatter's own config goes in with those bodies whatever kind its name says.
A config handed in is the config that run is made with.
The scratch root goes whether the run finished or threw.
A path reaching outside the repository is formatted by no run over many bodies.
A scratch root sits under `/var/tmp` rather than `/tmp`.
No refusal is spelt here.
This rewrites or does not.
The meaning of a body's trouble is left to the checks that judge the body.
How the formatter is configured is not answered here.
The config sitting in the root is picked up by the run.
Nothing restates the config.
Which kinds the formatter owns is answered here rather than by the formatter.
Those kinds are named here rather than read off the formatter's own config.
A caller hands in bodies by path and nothing about where those bodies are formatted.

definition: putting a body through the formatter this repo stands on, and taking back only what can be trusted
